description: Lighting drawing cases for firmware and Charybdis Ark: what the stages of docs/spec/rgb-domain-v1.md 'Drawing' paint, LED by LED, for a lighting profile, the keyboard's own key and LED tables and a still state. Each case names a profile, an RGB domain version 7 payload ('hex', with 'lighting' its fields as tests/host/profile_logical_form.py reads them), and gives its state and all 58 LEDs: leds[n] is LED n, 'rgb' the colour the renderer writes for it (rgb_matrix_set_color), 'hsv' the colour a stage picked, null where QMK or the idle timeout turns it off, and 'by' the owner that painted it last. 'rgb' is QMK's hsv_to_rgb (quantum/color.c, no CIE curve) of 'hsv', and every colour is chosen so that it is exact: hue 0, 85 or 170 at saturation 255 gives (v, 0, 0), (0, v, 0) or (0, 0, v), saturation 0 gives (v, v, v). Every colour belongs to one owner, so a colour names the stage that painted it. The expected LEDs were written from the spec and D-F62, D-F63, D-F73, D-F74 and D-F75, not from the renderer's output; tests/host/run_rgb_layer_render_tests.sh draws every case through the real render path and checks the board against the keyboard's tables.

board.source: keyboards/bastardkb/charybdis/4x6/keyboard.json at the BK commit qmk-pin.json names: layouts.LAYOUT (key order) and rgb_matrix.layout (LED order, matrix positions, split_count 29 + 29)

keymap.description: Every case's keymap: the layout keys each layer maps (neither KC_NO nor KC_TRNS); every other key on every layer is KC_TRNS.

background.description: The background effect every lit case starts from: Solid colour, this HSV, on every LED.

layers.description: Layer colours only: 0 red every key, 1 green mapped keys, 2 blue every key, 3 passthrough at hue 85 every key, 4 white mapped, 5 red mapped, 6 green mapped, 7 to 15 passthrough. No accents; every other owner passthrough.

layer-accents.description: 'layers' with six layer accents: layer 1 black on LED 10, layer 1 blue on LEDs 10 and 11, layer 3 white on LED 20, layer 3 black on LED 21, every layer off (0, 255, 0) on LED 22, every layer black on LED 23.

full.description: 'layers' with layer 2's red accent on LED 1; slots 1 green left half (own white accent LED 5), 2 blue both halves, 3 red half of the key, 5 blue keys only, 6 passthrough with no coloured accent, 7 passthrough with a white accent on LED 31, an every-slot black accent on LED 35; combo green keys only with a black accent on LED 8; tap branches blue half of the key, red keys only, green and white both halves; tap committed green both, hold white left half, long hold blue right half, behaviour accents stored as tap count 2 black LED 42, every tap branch red LEDs 41 and 42, every case black LEDs 40 and 41, hold green LED 43; replacement text red keys only, macro green half of the key, undone passthrough, leading blue both halves, accents text white LED 10 then every case black LEDs 9 and 10.

full-pointing-stage-off.description: 'full' with the pointing stage's bit (2) clear.

full-layer-stage-off.description: 'full' with the layer stage's bit (0) clear.

cases.name: base-layer-alone
cases.description: Only the base layer is on: its every-key colour on all 58 LEDs, the two keyless right-half LEDs included.

cases.name: higher-layer-covers-lower
cases.description: Layer 2 (every key) over the base on every shared LED.

cases.name: mapped-keys-over-every-key
cases.description: Layer 1 paints only the keys it maps (layout 0, 1 and 55: LEDs 0, 7 and 55, the last the lower right thumb key) over the base's every key.

cases.name: layers-lowest-first
cases.description: Layers 1, 2 and 4 on: layer 2's every key covers layer 1's mapped keys, and layer 4's mapped keys (layout 12 and 13) cover layer 2.

cases.name: passthrough-layer-shows-the-one-below
cases.description: Layer 3 is passthrough (saturation and value 0, at hue 85) over every key: layer 2 below it shows on every LED.

cases.name: layer-accents-in-stored-order
cases.description: Layer 1's black accent paints LED 10 in layer 1's colour, though it maps no key there; its blue accent stored after it repaints LEDs 10 and 11. The off accent for every layer turns LED 22 dark; the black accent for every layer takes each layer on in turn, lowest first, so LED 23 ends in layer 1's colour.

cases.name: accents-of-a-passthrough-layer
cases.description: Layer 3 is passthrough: its coloured accent still paints LED 20, its black accent paints nothing on LED 21 (the base shows), and the black accent for every layer ends LED 23 in the base's colour, since layer 3 has none.

cases.name: pointing-mode-over-every-layer
cases.description: Slot 1 runs from layout key 0 with no link, layers 2 and 4 on: its left-half colour covers every layer there, layer 2's accent on LED 1 and layer 4's keys included; its own accent paints LED 5 and the every-slot black accent LED 35 on the right half in its colour.

cases.name: pointing-mode-linked-layer-off
cases.description: Slot 1 linked to layer 5, which is off: it paints over every layer, as an unlinked mode does.

cases.name: pointing-mode-key-half
cases.description: Slot 3 paints the half of its key: layout 11 is on the right half. The every-slot accent paints LED 35.

cases.name: pointing-mode-key-half-no-key
cases.description: Slot 3 with no known key paints both halves.

cases.name: pointing-mode-keys-only
cases.description: Slot 5 paints only its key, layout 0 (LED 0), and the every-slot accent LED 35.

cases.name: pointing-mode-keys-only-no-key
cases.description: Slot 5 with no known key paints every LED.

cases.name: linked-mode-beneath-its-layer
cases.description: Slot 2 (both halves) linked to layer 4, its key turning on layer 5; layers 2, 4 and 6 on. It paints beneath layer 4, the lowest of its link that is on: over layer 2 and layer 2's accent on LED 1, under layer 4's keys (LEDs 1 and 6) and the keys of layer 6 (LEDs 2 and 30), which is not linked.

cases.name: linked-mode-beneath-the-layer-its-key-turns-on
cases.description: Slot 2 with layers 2, 5 and 6 on: layer 5, which its key turns on, is the lowest of its link on, so layer 5's key (LED 29) and layer 6's (LEDs 2 and 30) show over it.

cases.name: passthrough-slot-leaves-the-stack-whole
cases.description: Slot 6 is passthrough with no coloured accent, linked to layer 4, layers 2, 4 and 6 on: it has nothing to paint, so the layer stack stays whole and layer 2's accent, a row, repaints LED 1 over layer 4's key.

cases.name: passthrough-slot-with-coloured-accent-splits-the-stack
cases.description: Slot 7 is passthrough with a coloured accent on LED 31: it paints beneath layer 4, so layer 4's key covers layer 2's accent on LED 1; its accent paints LED 31 and its locality nothing.

cases.name: combo-over-everything
cases.description: A held combo of layout keys 36 and 47 (LEDs 3 and 32) whose output is not the pointing mode paints over slot 1 on the left half, and its black accent LED 8 in its colour.

cases.name: combo-beneath-the-mode-it-runs
cases.description: The same combo running slot 1 paints beneath it: the mode covers LEDs 3 and 8 on the left half, and LED 32 on the right keeps the combo's colour.

cases.name: combo-beneath-over-a-mode-beneath-a-layer
cases.description: The combo runs slot 2, which paints beneath layer 4: stage 3 comes after the layer stage, so the combo covers the mode and the layers on LEDs 3, 8 and 32.

cases.name: behaviour-tap-branch-and-accents
cases.description: Layout key 0 (left) shows the tap branch for tap count 2, its locality the half of the key: the left half. Accents: every case (LEDs 40, 41, black, in the branch's colour), then every tap branch (41, 42 red), then its own (42, black), whatever their stored order.

cases.name: behaviour-tap-count-3-keys-only
cases.description: Layout key 12 (LED 1) shows the tap branch for tap count 3, locality its key alone; the every-case and every-tap-branch accents paint, the tap count 2 accent does not.

cases.name: behaviour-on-the-lower-right-thumb-key
cases.description: Layout key 55, the lower right thumb key (LED 55), shows the tap branch for tap count 3, locality its key alone, over layer 1's mapped keys, which include it: its colour paints LED 55, and the every-case and every-tap-branch accents paint LEDs 40 to 42.

cases.name: behaviour-hold-over-the-pointing-mode
cases.description: Layout key 11 (right half) shows hold, whose locality is the left half: it covers slot 1 there. The every-case accent paints LEDs 40, 41 in hold's colour and hold's own coloured accent LED 43; the tap-branch accents do not.

cases.name: replacement-over-everything
cases.description: Text replaced on layout key 0 (LED 0, keys only) over layers, a linked mode, a combo and hold: its colour on LED 0, the every-case black accent on LEDs 9 and 10 in its colour, then its own accent on LED 10.

cases.name: replacement-key-unknown
cases.description: Text replaced with no known key, keys only: every LED.

cases.name: replacement-passthrough-case
cases.description: Undone is passthrough: neither its locality nor the every-case black accent paints, so what is beneath shows.

cases.name: pointing-stage-off-leaves-the-stack-whole
cases.description: With the pointing stage off a linked mode has nothing to paint: the stack stays whole, as for a passthrough slot.

cases.name: layer-stage-off
cases.description: With the layer stage off no layer or layer accent paints: the background shows except where slot 1 paints.

cases.name: lighting-off
cases.description: QMK's lighting switch is off: its effect is none and it runs no stage, so every LED is dark.

cases.name: idle-timeout
cases.description: The last input is older than the lighting idle timeout: after the stages every LED is turned off.
